correctness.rationale: The two source pullback identities imply that \(A\otimes\omega_X\) pulls back trivially along the finite flat degree-two map, and the norm gives its square trivial, hence \(A^2\cong\omega_X^{-2}\). The foliation derivation identifies degree-two descended sections with the kernel of \(D:R_2\to R_3\). The support of \(D(q)\) forces away a possible linear multiple of the quadric; after subtracting the cubic relation it reduces to the polynomial kernel, which is exactly the seven coordinate squares. A fresh independent \(\mathbf F_2\) rank computation found rank \(21\) on the 28-dimensional quadratic space and kernel dimension \(7\). The seven squares have no common zero. Their pullback map is relative Frobenius on the integral fourfold, of degree \(16\); dividing by the degree-two cover gives degree \(8\).
